identity.name: Ballard Reach Floating Commons
identity.concept: A playable cluster of floating fish exchanges, repair pontoons, and shared platforms grounded in Ballard Reach’s fisheries, repair yards, maritime independence, and Currentborn communities.
identity.description: A working network of floating fish exchanges, repair pontoons, and shared platforms where practical help, crew trust, and shifting moorings shape access and opportunity.

design.encounterPurpose: A Tier 2 social environment that makes working relationships shape passage, supplies, information, and navigation without treating Ballard Reach residents as default adversaries.
impulses: turn moving platforms into timing complications
offer concrete work instead of hostility
design.designerNotes: Mechanics and Fast Play were approved by the GM before packaging. The floating structures are new encounter details grounded in established Ballard Reach lore; residents are not default adversaries.

prompts.label: Opening
prompts.text: Open amid active work and let PCs offer practical help.

prompts.label: Access
prompts.text: Use Crew’s Word for passage, supplies, or leads; after failure, give a concrete task before another attempt.

prompts.label: Mutual Aid
prompts.text: Reward freely given help with Mutual Aid when PCs negotiate or navigate the Commons.

prompts.label: Complication
prompts.text: Use Shift the Moorings when platform movement creates a useful navigable timing problem.

fastPlay.goal: Make working relationships shape access and opportunity without portraying the district as hostile.

impulses: turn moving platforms into timing complications
offer concrete work instead of hostility

features.name: Working Berths
features.rules: Once per scene, a PC who spends time helping with a practical task can clear 1 Stress.

features.name: Crew’s Word
features.rules: A PC seeking passage, supplies, or information makes a Presence or Instinct Roll (14). Success with Hope secures fair terms and a useful lead. Success with Fear secures terms with one clearly stated small favor owed. On a failure, the crew offers a concrete task to complete before trying again; failure with Fear also delays access until that task is done.

features.name: Mutual Aid
features.rules: Once per PC per scene, helping a resident without demanding payment grants advantage on that PC’s next roll to negotiate or navigate the Commons in this scene; it expires on use or at scene end.

features.name: Shift the Moorings
features.rules: Spend a Fear when platform movement matters. A pontoon separates; PCs crossing make an Agility Reaction Roll (14). Failure marks 1 Stress and puts the PC on an adjacent secured craft; success keeps them on the intended platform. A successful Agility or Finesse Roll (14) reconnects the route; separation otherwise ends with the scene.
